title: The optimal log log q bound in the Pólya-Vinogradov inequality — submission package
description:
The optimal log log q bound in the Pólya-Vinogradov inequality. Hexagon/Overleaf and Journal of Number Theory submission preparation, version 1.4.0. The reviewed folder Paper_6 package contains the article PDF, a minimal compilable TeX ZIP, AI provenance, Hexagon fields, journal details, an unsent cover letter with editable source, and an author-prepared AI disclosure. All PDFs have no row or margin line numbers. No journal submission or acceptance is claimed.

The manuscript derives the optimal-order log log q character-sum bound and related logarithmic-derivative results from the credited zero-free theorem, with explicit parameters and a smooth Mobius equivalence. The complete formal source and exact endpoint audit passed. OpenAI's zero-free proof remains credited; no newly independent proof is claimed.

Verification scope: The complete current source build, all 19 original and seven closed endpoint axiom reports, and all 20 analytic component reports passed. The reports use only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. The separate written cyclotomic identification is not a new Lean statement, and the revised exposition is not a line-by-line formalisation. No independent zero-free proof is claimed.

Original preprint: https://hexagonmath.org/2610.00256v2. Earlier manuscript/source DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23629139. Original attribution and component licences are preserved. Human-understanding and mixed-text declarations record the submitting author's explicit statement on 25 October 2026. The standalone AI declaration is author-prepared, not an official signed publisher form.
